verses.text: Ix yak'anem spoder Jehová t'a wib'anh, haxo Yespíritu ix ak'an wila'', ichato ayinek' t'a jun panhan b'aj b'ut'an yuj juntzanh b'ak.
Ix in yik'anek' Jehová t'a skaltak juntzanh b'ak chi', ix wilani majnakel sat lum panhan chi' yuj juntzanh sb'akil anima chi'. Te tzijtum juntzanh b'ak chi', te takinhxo.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, ¿tzam yal spitzwixi juntzanh takinh b'ak tik tza na'? xchi. Ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Mamin Dios Wajalil, a achnhej ojtak, xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a juntzanh takinh b'ak tik to scha yab' in lolonel heb'.
Al t'a heb' to a in Jehová Yajal in swal icha tik: Ol wak'xioch eyik' yik tzex pitzwixi.

Ol wak' eyamlajxi he b'a, ol wak'anxioch he b'ak'chil, ol ochxipax he tz'umal, ol wak'anxi eyik' eyik', ol ex pitzwokxok. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová in, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.

Ix walan t'a heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin. Yakb'an wan walan chi' t'a heb', ix wab'an sk'anh jun tas, tikni tob'an kixkab' ix eq'ui, icha chi' ix aj yoch ijan syamanxi sb'a juntzanh b'ak chi'.
Haxo ix wilani, wan syamanxi sb'a juntzanh b'ak chi', ayxo och sch'anhal, sb'ak'chil yet' stz'umal. Anhej to manto yik'laj yik' heb'.

Ix wab'an yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, al t'a ik' icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ach ik', kotanh t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal, tzach ochkan t'a juntzanh niwanil chamnakxo tik, yik spitzwixi heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ix walan icha ix yutej yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin, ix och yik' juntzanh niwanil chi', ix pitzwixi heb', ix k'e linhan heb'. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb' icha junok niwan nhilanh heb' soldado.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach anima, a ex chonhab' Israel ex tik, lajan ex icha juntzanh b'ak tik. Tzeyal icha tik: Takinhxo ko b'akil, manhxa tas ayoch yipok ko k'ool, toxo ix onh sateli, xe chi.
Yuj chi' al yab' heb' etchonhab' tik to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ex in chonhab', ol in jak b'aj mukan ex, ol ex wik'anelta ta', ol ex wak'an meltzaj t'a he chonhab'.
Ayik ol in jakan b'aj mukan ex chi', ol ex wik'anelta, ol eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová in he Diosal in.

Ha in wal swala' to ol wak'och Wespíritu t'ayex, haxo he pitzwi chi', haxo ex wak'anxikan kajnaj t'a he lu'um chi'. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová in walnak juntzanh tik, ix wak'anpaxelk'ochi, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ach anima, say chab'ok te te', tza tz'ib'anoch t'a junok te' icha tik: Ha te' sch'oxan Judá yet' heb' yetisraelal ajun yet'ok. Slajwi chi' tza tz'ib'anpaxoch t'a junxo te' icha tik: Ha te' sch'oxan Efraín yinhtilal José yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ajun yet'ok. Icha chi' tz'aj a tz'ib'ani.
Slajwi chi' tzak'an yil-laj sb'a snhi' te' t'a yol a k'ab', ichato junnhej te'al te'.
Tato ol sk'anb'ej heb' etchonhab' t'ayach icha tik: Al t'ayonh tas syalelk'och jun tza ch'ox tik, ta xchi heb',

tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová Yajal: Ol wik'k'e te' sch'oxan yinhtilal José, te' ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' Efraín yet' juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel ayoch yet'ok, ol wak'an yil-laj sb'a te' yet' te' sch'oxan Judá, junnhej ol wutej chab' te te' chi' t'a yol in k'ab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
T'a wal yichanh heb' tzik'ank'e te te' chi' schab'il, haton te' b'aj ix a tz'ib'ejoch chi',
tzalan icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan icha tik: Ol ex wik'elta t'a skaltak juntzanh nakión b'aj k'ochnak ex kani. Yalnhej b'aj ayex eq'ui ol ex wak'anxi meltzaj t'a sat he lu'um.
Junxonhej chonhab'il ol ex wutej t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Israel chi', junxonhej he reyal ol wak'ochi. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol ex pojchajb'atok. Manhxo chab'ok nakión ol ex ajok.

Manhxo ol eyixtejb'at he b'a yet' juntzanh he komon Dios yajb'entak chi', ma yet' juntzanhokxo makanhil chukal tze k'ulej. Yujto ol wik'el he pitalil, ol wik'anel he mul ayoch t'a eyib'anh. Ol ex ochxok in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in ochxok he Diosalok.
Haton winh in chekab' yinhtilal winhaj David ol och he reyalok yet' he tanhwumalok he masanil. Ol he k'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il.

Ol ex kajnajxok t'a jun lu'um wak'nak t'a winh in chekab' aj Jacob, haton lum b'aj ek'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Hata' ol kajnaj heb' eyuninal yet' masanil heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Haxo winh in chekab' yinhtilal winhaj David ol ochnhej he reyalok.

Ol wak' in trato yik junk'olal heyet'ok, yik wach' ol ex aj t'a tzalajk'olal. T'a junelnhej ol in b'okan jun in trato chi' heyet'ok, yik tzalajk'olalnhej ol ex ajok. Ol wak'an q'uib' he b'isul, t'a masanil tiempo ol kan in templo t'a he kal.
Ol in kajnaj t'a he kal, ol in ochxok he Diosalok, a exxo ol ex ochxok in chonhab'ok.
Ol aj in templo chi' t'a he kal t'a junelnhej, haxo masanil juntzanhxo nakión ol nachajel yuj heb' to sik'b'il ex el wuuj yik tzex ochkan wikok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
